fusions.name: Peel the Plate
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 30 damage, ignoring the target's armour, and leaves it 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulwark Shove
fusions.desc: Drives your shoulder plate through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 12 damage to everything in it, knocks each enemy back 3 tiles and leaves it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoulder the Blow
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 12% while it holds.

fusions.name: Harness None Could Lift
fusions.desc: Conjures a harness of heavy plate: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 12, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
